devices.name: Router1
devices.last_config:
!
! ===== ROUTER : R1 (auto-generated from topology) =====
!
hostname R1
!
no ip domain-lookup
ip domain-name lab.local
service password-encryption
!
ip routing
!
ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.100.1 192.168.100.1
ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.1.1 192.168.1.1
!
ip dhcp pool LAN_GigabitEthernet0_1
 network 192.168.100.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 192.168.100.1
 dns-server 8.8.8.8
!
ip dhcp pool LAN_GigabitEthernet0_3
 network 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 192.168.1.1
 dns-server 8.8.8.8
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description ### LAN 192.168.100.0/24 ###
 ip address 192.168.100.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/3
 description ### LAN 192.168.1.0/24 ###
 ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/5
 description ### Link to R2 ###
 ip address 10.1.1.2 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description ### Link to R2 ###
 ip address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
access-list 10 permit 192.168.100.0 0.0.0.255
access-list 11 permit 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255
!
ip nat inside source list 10 interface GigabitEthernet0/5 overload
ip nat inside source list 11 interface GigabitEthernet0/5 overload
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 1.1.1.1
 passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/3
 network 192.168.100.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.1.1.0 0.0.0.3 area 0
 network 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.3 area 0
!
router bgp 65001
 bgp router-id 1.1.1.1
 bgp log-neighbor-changes
 network 192.168.100.0 mask 255.255.255.0
 network 192.168.1.0 mask 255.255.255.0
 neighbor 10.1.1.1 remote-as 65002
 neighbor 10.10.10.2 remote-as 65002
!
banner motd ^C Authorized access only - R1 ^C
!
line con 0
 logging synchronous
!
end

devices.name: Switch1
devices.last_config:
!
! ===== SWITCH : SW1 (auto-generated from topology) =====
!
hostname SW1
!
no ip domain-lookup
!
spanning-tree mode pvst
!
vlan 100
 name DATA_VLAN100
!
interface FastEthernet0/1
 description ### Uplink to R1 - DATA_VLAN100 (192.168.100.0/24) ###
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 100
 no shutdown
!
interface range FastEthernet0/1-24
 description ### DATA_VLAN100 access ###
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 100
 spanning-tree portfast
 no shutdown
!
banner motd ^C Authorized access only - SW1 ^C
!
line con 0
 logging synchronous
!
end
